mainTopic: The טומאה of עבודה זרה: is it like a שרץ or like a נדה? רבה and רבי אלעזר explain the מחלוקת between רבי עקיבא and the רבנן differently.
overview: The גמרא finishes quoting a משנה from מסכת עבודה זרה about a house used for idol worship. Its stones, wood and dust are טמא. The תנא קמא compares this טומאה to a שרץ, but רבי עקיבא compares it to a נדה, which makes things טמא even through carrying (משא). רבה explains the פסוק ״תזרם״ as 'treat idols like strangers.' He then says everyone agrees about משא, and the argument is only about אבן מסמא, a very heavy stone. The גמרא asks what the other comparison teaches on each side. For רבי עקיבא, the שרץ comparison is for the idol's accessories. For the רבנן, the נדה comparison teaches משא. When the גמרא asks why the Torah did not simply compare it to a נבלה, it answers that the נדה comparison also teaches that there is no טומאה through limbs. The גמרא then shows that רב חמא בר גוריא's question about limbs was asked only according to רבי עקיבא. Finally, רבי אלעזר reverses רבה's approach: everyone agrees there is no אבן מסמא, and they argue about משא.

steps.title: A wall shared with an idolatry house is split half and half
steps.stepSummary: The quoted משנה rules that when a wall belonged half to a person and half to a house of עבודה זרה, it is calculated half and half.
steps.simpleTranslation: If the wall was his and also belonged to the idolatry house, it is judged half and half.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is in the middle of quoting a משנה from מסכת עבודה זרה about a wall that bordered a house of idolatry. This line deals with a wall owned jointly by the person and the idolatry house.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The full משנה teaches that if a wall next to an idolatry house fell, the owner must rebuild it further back on his own land so he does not help the idolatry house. If the wall was jointly owned, the amount he must move back is calculated from the middle, half and half. The גמרא quotes this משנה because of the next line, which is about טומאה.

keyTerms.meaning: Idolatry; here, a house used for idol worship
It is judged / calculated
Half and half

steps.confusionAlert: This עמוד starts in the middle of a quoted משנה. The main point for our סוגיא is the next line about טומאה, not the wall itself.

phrases.english: If [the wall] was his and belonged to the idolatry [house],
it is judged half and half.
phrases.notes: The distance he must move back is calculated from the middle of the wall.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues a משנה being quoted from מסכת עבודה זרה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A jointly owned wall bordering an idolatry house is calculated half and half.

steps.title: The materials of an idolatry house are טמא like a שרץ
steps.stepSummary: The תנא קמא says the stones, wood and dust of an idolatry house make things טמא like a שרץ, based on the פסוק ״שקץ תשקצנו״.
steps.simpleTranslation: Its stones, its wood and its dust make things טמא like a שרץ, as it says: 'You shall utterly detest it (שקץ תשקצנו)…'
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the first opinion on what kind of טומאה an idolatry house has. It compares it to a שרץ.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word שקץ is the Torah's word for creeping creatures (שרצים), so the משנה links עבודה זרה to שרץ. A שרץ makes things טמא only by touch (מגע), not by carrying (משא). This טומאה of עבודה זרה is generally understood to be rabbinic, and the פסוק is used as a support.

keyTerms.meaning: A creeping creature whose carcass makes things טמא by touch
They make things ritually impure
'You shall utterly detest it' (דברים ז:כו)

phrases.english: Its stones, its wood, and its dust
transmit impurity like a creeping creature,
as it is stated: 'You shall utterly detest it,' etc.
phrases.notes: שקץ is the term used for שרצים.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the quoted משנה with its rule about טומאה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The materials of an idolatry house are טמא like a שרץ.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא: idolatry is טמא like a נדה, even through carrying
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא compares עבודה זרה to a נדה, based on ״תזרם כמו דוה״. So just as a נדה makes things טמא through carrying, so does עבודה זרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי עקיבא says: like a נדה, as it says, 'You will cast them away like a menstruating woman.' Just as a נדה makes things טמא through carrying, so too עבודה זרה makes things טמא through carrying.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא disagrees with the first opinion and compares עבודה זרה to a נדה instead of a שרץ.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word דוה in ישעיהו means a נדה. A נדה has a stronger טומאה than a שרץ: she makes a person טמא even if he only carries her without touching (משא). So for רבי עקיבא, עבודה זרה also makes things טמא through משא.

keyTerms.meaning: A menstruating woman, who carries a strong טומאה
'You will cast them away like a menstruating woman' (ישעיהו ל:כב)
Carrying; impurity passed by moving something without touching it

steps.whyThisMatters: This is the source of the משנה's question in our פרק about where we learn that עבודה זרה makes things טמא through משא.

phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva says: like a menstruating woman,
as it is stated: 'You will cast them away like a menstruating woman' —
just as a menstruating woman transmits impurity through carrying,
so too idolatry transmits impurity through carrying.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a disagreeing opinion to the תנא קמא.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי עקיבא, עבודה זרה makes things טמא through משא, like a נדה.

steps.title: רבה explains the verse: push idolatry far away
steps.stepSummary: רבה reads ״תזרם״ as 'make them foreign (זר) to you,' and the end of the פסוק, ״צא תאמר לו״, as meaning you must never say 'come in' to it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה said: When the verse says 'תזרם,' it means: make them strangers to you. 'You will say to it: Get out' — never say to it: Come in.
steps.whatsHappening: רבה pauses to explain the meaning of the פסוק that רבי עקיבא quoted. This is an explanation of the verse, not a new law.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבה connects the word תזרם to זר, a stranger: treat idols as completely foreign to you. The end of the פסוק, ״צא תאמר לו״, teaches that the relationship only goes one way. You send it out and never welcome it back.

keyTerms.meaning: Make them foreign / estranged
Like a stranger
'You will say to it: Get out'

phrases.english: Rabba said:
'You will cast them away,' which the verse says,
[means:] make them foreign to you like a stranger.
'You will say to it: Get out' —
'Come in,' do not say to it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the פסוק cited by רבי עקיבא.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: ״תזרם״ means to treat idolatry as completely foreign, sending it away and never inviting it in.

steps.title: רבה: everyone agrees about carrying, and they argue about the heavy stone
steps.stepSummary: רבה says all agree that עבודה זרה makes things טמא through משא, because the פסוק compares it to a נדה. The argument is only about אבן מסמא: רבי עקיבא says it does make things טמא this way like a נדה, and the רבנן say it does not, like a שרץ.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה also said: About carrying, everyone agrees that it makes things טמא, because it is compared to a נדה. Where they argue is the very heavy stone. רבי עקיבא holds it is like a נדה: just as a נדה makes things טמא through a heavy stone, so does עבודה זרה. The רבנן hold it is like a שרץ: just as a שרץ does not make things טמא through a heavy stone, neither does עבודה זרה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבה now defines exactly what רבי עקיבא and the רבנן argue about. He says it is not about משא at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both opinions accept both פסוקים, so even the רבנן agree that עבודה זרה has משא, like a נדה. The argument is over a special נדה law called אבן מסמא. If a נדה sits on a huge stone that has vessels underneath, the vessels become טמא even though her weight makes no difference to them. רבי עקיבא compares עבודה זרה to a נדה fully, while the רבנן limit it here and compare it to a שרץ.

keyTerms.meaning: A very heavy stone; a נדה sitting on it makes the vessels beneath it טמא
Everyone agrees; there is no argument
It was compared (by a היקש, a comparison in the פסוק)
Where they do argue

steps.confusionAlert: Do not assume the רבנן deny משא. In רבה's version, everyone agrees about משא. The argument is only about אבן מסמא.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up all the questions that follow: if each side uses both comparisons, what does each comparison teach?

phrases.english: And Rabba said:

phrases.aramaic: בְּמַשָּׂא דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא לָא פְּלִיגִי דִּמְטַמְּאָה,
phrases.english: Regarding carrying, everyone agrees that it transmits impurity,
since it was compared to a menstruating woman.
Where they argue is regarding a very heavy stone.
Rabbi Akiva holds: like a menstruating woman —
just as a menstruating woman transmits impurity via a very heavy stone,

phrases.aramaic: אַף עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה מְטַמְּאָה בְּאֶבֶן מְסָמָא.
phrases.english: so too idolatry transmits impurity via a very heavy stone.
And the Rabbis hold: like a creeping creature —

phrases.aramaic: מָה שֶׁרֶץ לֹא מְטַמֵּא בְּאֶבֶן מְסָמָא —
phrases.english: just as a creeping creature does not transmit impurity via a very heavy stone,

phrases.aramaic: אַף עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה לֹא מְטַמְּאָה בְּאֶבֶן מְסָמָא.
phrases.english: so too idolatry does not transmit impurity via a very heavy stone.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאָמַר רַבָּה: בְּמַשָּׂא דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא לָא פְּלִיגִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Redefines the scope of the מחלוקת between the תנא קמא and רבי עקיבא.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבה, all agree that עבודה זרה has משא. They argue only about אבן מסמא.

steps.title: For רבי עקיבא, what does the שרץ comparison teach?
steps.stepSummary: If רבי עקיבא treats עבודה זרה fully like a נדה, why compare it to a שרץ at all? The answer: the שרץ comparison applies to its accessories (משמשיה).
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to רבי עקיבא, for what law was it compared to a שרץ? For its accessories.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks what job the שרץ comparison does for רבי עקיבא, and answers that it refers to items used in serving the idol.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי עקיבא, the idol itself is like a נדה in every way, so the שרץ פסוק would seem pointless. The answer is that the idol's accessories have the weaker, שרץ-level טומאה. They make things טמא only by touch.

keyTerms.meaning: For what law? (asking what a source teaches)
Its accessories; utensils used in serving the idol

phrases.english: And according to Rabbi Akiva,
for what law was it compared to a creeping creature?
For its accessories.
phrases.notes: The accessories are טמא only like a שרץ.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּלְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, לְמַאי הִלְכְתָא אִיתַּקַּשׁ לְשֶׁרֶץ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tests רבה's explanation from רבי עקיבא's side.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What the שרץ comparison teaches according to רבי עקיבא.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: It teaches the law for the idol's accessories, which are טמא like a שרץ.

steps.title: For the רבנן, what does the נדה comparison teach?
steps.stepSummary: If the רבנן compare עבודה זרה to a שרץ, what do they learn from the נדה comparison? The answer: משא.
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to the רבנן, for what law was it compared to a נדה? For carrying.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks the same question from the other side, and answers that for the רבנן the נדה comparison teaches משא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This fits רבה's claim that everyone agrees about משא. The רבנן take only the משא law from נדה and nothing more, such as אבן מסמא. This answer sets up the next challenge.

keyTerms.meaning: For the law of carrying

phrases.english: And according to the Rabbis,
for what law was it compared to a menstruating woman?
For carrying.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Same question as Step 6, now from the רבנן's side.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What the נדה comparison teaches according to the רבנן.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: It teaches that עבודה זרה makes things טמא through משא.

steps.title: Why not just compare it to a נבלה?
steps.stepSummary: If the רבנן want משא without אבן מסמא, a נבלה (animal carcass) has exactly that. So why didn't the Torah simply compare עבודה זרה to a נבלה?
steps.simpleTranslation: Let the Torah compare it to a נבלה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the previous answer. One comparison to a נבלה would give the רבנן's whole result, so why use both נדה and שרץ?
steps.deeperAnalysis: A נבלה makes things טמא through משא but not through אבן מסמא. That is exactly the רבנן's position on עבודה זרה. So the double comparison to נדה and שרץ seems unnecessary.

keyTerms.meaning: An animal that died without proper שחיטה; it is טמא through touch and carrying
Then let Him compare it
The Merciful One, i.e., the Torah

phrases.english: Then let the Torah compare it to an animal carcass!
phrases.notes: A נבלה has משא but no אבן מסמא.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the answer given in Step 7.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the רבנן use the נדה comparison only for משא.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: One comparison to נבלה would produce the same result (משא without אבן מסמא), so the נדה comparison would be unnecessary.

steps.title: The נדה comparison teaches that limbs do not carry טומאה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא agrees that נבלה would cover משא. But the נדה comparison adds something more: just as a נדה does not transmit טומאה through separate limbs, neither does עבודה זרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Yes, that is true. But the point is: just as a נדה does not transmit טומאה through limbs, so too עבודה זרה does not transmit טומאה through limbs.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the נבלה challenge by finding a different, special lesson in the נדה comparison.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גמרא admits that for משא alone, נבלה would be enough. The reason the Torah chose נדה is to teach a rule that a נבלה does not have. A נבלה's limbs can carry טומאה, but a נדה has no limb-טומאה. So a broken-off part of an idol is not טמא.

keyTerms.meaning: Yes, that is indeed so
It has no טומאה through limbs / separate parts

phrases.english: Yes, it is indeed so; rather:
phrases.notes: Admits the point, then adds something new.

phrases.english: just as a menstruating woman has no impurity through limbs,
so too idolatry has no impurity through limbs.
phrases.notes: A broken piece of an idol is not טמא.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Concedes the point and identifies a new, unique lesson in the comparison.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The נדה comparison is only for משא, so a נבלה comparison would have been enough.
steps.terutzMaskana: The נדה comparison teaches that עבודה זרה has no limb-טומאה, which a נבלה comparison could not teach.

steps.title: Then why was רב חמא בר גוריא unsure about limbs?
steps.stepSummary: רב חמא בר גוריא asked whether עבודה זרה has limb-טומאה. According to the previous answer, he could have solved it from the רבנן!
steps.simpleTranslation: But then, what about the question asked by רב חמא בר גוריא: does עבודה זרה have טומאה through limbs or not? Solve it from here, since for the רבנן it has none!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the answer from Step 9 by pointing to an אמורא who treated this exact question as unsolved.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If a היקש openly teaches that עבודה זרה has no limb-טומאה, there would be nothing to ask. Yet רב חמא בר גוריא asked it as an open question. That suggests the answer in Step 9 is wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: Asked as an open question (בעיא)
It does have טומאה through limbs
Resolve it / settle the question

phrases.aramaic: וְאֶלָּא הָא דְּבָעֵי רַב חָמָא בַּר גּוּרְיָא:
phrases.english: But then, that which Rav Chama bar Gurya asked:
Does idolatry have impurity through limbs
or does it not have impurity through limbs?
Let him resolve it from this,
that according to the Rabbis it has no impurity through limbs!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֶלָּא הָא דְּבָעֵי רַב חָמָא בַּר גּוּרְיָא
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the נדה comparison teaches that there is no limb-טומאה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If this were clearly taught, רב חמא בר גוריא would not have asked it as an open question.

steps.title: רב חמא בר גוריא asked according to רבי עקיבא
steps.stepSummary: רב חמא בר גוריא's question was according to רבי עקיבא, who uses the נדה comparison for a different purpose. So for him the question stays open.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב חמא בר גוריא asked his question according to רבי עקיבא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by limiting רב חמא בר גוריא's question to רבי עקיבא's opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For the רבנן, the limb rule is indeed settled by the נדה comparison. רבי עקיבא, however, already uses the נדה comparison for משא and אבן מסמא, so it does not clearly settle limbs for him. That is where the question remains open.

keyTerms.meaning: According to the opinion of

steps.whatToRemember: In רבה's approach, everyone agrees about משא, and the argument is about אבן מסמא. For רבי עקיבא, the שרץ comparison is for the accessories. For the רבנן, the נדה comparison teaches משא and that there is no limb-טומאה.

phrases.english: Rav Chama bar Gurya
asked it according to Rabbi Akiva.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַב חָמָא בַּר גּוּרְיָא אַלִּיבָּא דְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא בָּעֵי לַהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of Step 10 and closes רבה's approach.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the question to one opinion.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רב חמא בר גוריא's question applies to everyone, so it contradicts the limb rule.
steps.terutzMaskana: The question was only according to רבי עקיבא. For the רבנן, the matter is settled.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר: everyone agrees about the heavy stone, and they argue about carrying
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר reverses רבה's approach. All agree that עבודה זרה has no אבן מסמא. The argument is about משא: רבי עקיבא says yes, like a נדה, and the רבנן say no, like a שרץ.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אלעזר said: About the heavy stone, everyone agrees that it does not make things טמא. Where they argue is carrying. רבי עקיבא holds it is like a נדה: just as a נדה makes things טמא through carrying, so does עבודה זרה. The רבנן hold it is like a שרץ: just as a שרץ does not make things טמא through carrying, neither does עבודה זרה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא presents a second, opposite way of understanding the מחלוקת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי אלעזר, the simple reading of the משנה is correct: רבי עקיבא added משא, and the רבנן do not hold of משא at all. No one holds that עבודה זרה has אבן מסמא. This flips which law is agreed upon and which is argued about.

keyTerms.meaning: That it does not make things טמא
Holds / they hold

steps.confusionAlert: Keep the two approaches separate. In רבה's approach, everyone agrees about משא. In רבי אלעזר's approach, everyone agrees there is no אבן מסמא.

phrases.english: And Rabbi Elazar said:

phrases.aramaic: בְּאֶבֶן מְסָמָא דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא לָא פְּלִיגִי
phrases.english: Regarding a very heavy stone, everyone agrees
that it does not transmit impurity.
Where they argue is regarding carrying:
Rabbi Akiva holds: like a menstruating woman —
just as a menstruating woman transmits impurity through carrying,
so too idolatry transmits impurity through carrying.
And the Rabbis hold: like a creeping creature —
just as a creeping creature does not transmit impurity through carrying,

phrases.aramaic: אַף עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה לֹא מְטַמְּאָה בְּמַשָּׂא.
phrases.english: so too idolatry does not transmit impurity through carrying.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אָמַר: בְּאֶבֶן מְסָמָא דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא לָא פְּלִיגִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers the opposite definition of the מחלוקת from רבה's in Step 5.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי אלעזר, no one holds of אבן מסמא for עבודה זרה. רבי עקיבא holds of משא and the רבנן do not.

steps.title: For רבי עקיבא in רבי אלעזר's approach: the שרץ comparison is for accessories
steps.stepSummary: Again the גמרא asks why רבי עקיבא needs the שרץ comparison, and again the answer is: for the accessories.
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to רבי עקיבא, for what law was it compared to a שרץ? For its accessories.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא repeats the question from Step 6, now within רבי אלעזר's approach, and gives the same answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here the accessories are like a שרץ in that they make things טמא only by touch, not through משא. The idol itself makes things טמא through משא, like a נדה.

phrases.english: And Rabbi Akiva —
for what law was it compared to a creeping creature?
For its accessories.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, לְמַאי הִלְכְתָא אִיתַּקַּשׁ לְשֶׁרֶץ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tests רבי אלעזר's approach from רבי עקיבא's side.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What the שרץ comparison teaches for רבי עקיבא in this approach.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: It teaches that the accessories make things טמא only like a שרץ, without משא.

steps.title: For the רבנן in רבי אלעזר's approach: the נדה comparison is for limbs
steps.stepSummary: Since the רבנן here reject משא, the נדה comparison must teach something else. It teaches that עבודה זרה, like a נדה, has no limb-טומאה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the רבנן: for what law was it compared to a נדה? Just as a נדה has no טומאה through limbs, so too עבודה זרה has no טומאה through limbs.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks what the נדה comparison teaches for the רבנן in רבי אלעזר's approach, and answers with the limb rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In רבה's approach, the רבנן used the נדה comparison for משא, and the limb rule came up only to answer the נבלה challenge. In רבי אלעזר's approach, they reject משא, so the limb rule is the whole purpose of the נדה comparison.
steps.whatToRemember: There are two opposite ways to read the מחלוקת. רבה: all agree about משא, and they argue about אבן מסמא. רבי אלעזר: all agree there is no אבן מסמא, and they argue about משא. In both, רבי עקיבא's שרץ comparison is for the accessories, and the רבנן's נדה comparison teaches that there is no limb-טומאה.

phrases.english: And the Rabbis — for what law was it compared to a menstruating woman?
Just as a menstruating woman has no impurity through limbs,
so too idolatry has no impurity through limbs.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the testing of רבי אלעזר's approach from the רבנן's side.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What the נדה comparison teaches for the רבנן, who reject משא in this approach.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: It teaches that עבודה זרה has no limb-טומאה, just like a נדה.
